defect.problem: The citation, court, year, parallel cite, and Lexis cite match the lake record, but the asserted title is the input/common caption rather than the lake canonical case name; the lake records a caption-mismatch warning.
defect.proposed_fix: Use the lake canonical caption for identity metadata and keep "United States v. United States District Court (Keith)" as an alias or common title.

reasons: Lake official citation is 407 U.S. 297, court is U.S. Supreme Court, and year is 1972.
Lake parallel citations are 92 S. Ct. 2125 and 32 L. Ed. 2d 752; vendor-neutral citation is 1972 U.S. LEXIS 38.
Lake canonical case_name is United States v. United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, while input_case_name is United States v. United States District Court (Keith).
residual_risks: The common Keith caption is likely useful for navigation, but it should not be mistaken for the canonical caption.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Distinguish canonical caption from alias/common-name fields.

defect.problem: The Anchor home-role for Electronic Surveillance and Title III is not independently supportable from the disclosed evidence; the lake record contains no holding, home-role analysis, or supporting pinpoints, and no opinion text file is disclosed.
defect.proposed_fix: Provide text/<case>.txt or lake holding/pinpoints supporting the Anchor role, or downgrade the role to an unverified related-case placement.

reasons: The content page repeats the Anchor label, but that is the assertion under review and cannot self-verify.
The lake record supplies identity, citation, and treatment metadata, but no holding or role-support field.
residual_risks: The role may be correct if the full opinion text or verified lake holding is later disclosed.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add an independently pincited support note tying the case to the Title III/electronic-surveillance home role.

defect.problem: The stated holding cannot be verified at its breadth from the disclosed evidence; the lake record has no holding or pinpoints, and no cached full opinion text is present.
defect.proposed_fix: Provide the full opinion text or lake pinpoints/holding validating each component, especially the Section 2511(3) disclaimer, the prior-judicial-approval rule, and the foreign-powers reservation.

reasons: No text/<case>.txt file is disclosed for holding verification.
Lake pinpoints are empty and the lake record contains no holding field.
The content page's own holding and rule discussion cannot self-authenticate under the review rules.
residual_risks: The proposition may be accurate if later checked against the full opinion, but the disclosed record does not permit that verification.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Split the holding into separately supported propositions with separate pinpoints for Section 2511(3), domestic-security warrant approval, and the foreign-intelligence reservation.

reasons: The payload mirrors the disclosed lake treatment fields: field_i_validity unverified, null as-of fields, composite_basis unverified, and varies_by_point false.
residual_risks: No treatment or currency judgment is made under this lens.
